name: Gennesaret
line: Gennesaret was a fertile plain on the western shore of the Sea of Galilee, where Jesus landed from the boat and healed many sick people who came to Him.

moments.title: The sick are healed
moments.text: Jesus and His disciples landed at Gennesaret, and the people recognized Him. They brought all their sick, and everyone who touched the fringe of His cloak was healed.

moments.title: Healed in every place He went
moments.text: When they landed at Gennesaret, people recognized Jesus and ran through the whole region carrying the sick on mats. Everyone who touched the fringe of His cloak was healed.
